subject: general
question: A boy can swim in still water at a speed of 40 km/hr. If the speed of the current would have been 15 km/hr, then find the time in which the boy could swim 25 km upstream.
solution:
**Given:**

A boy can swim in still water at a speed of 40 km/hr.

The speed of the current would have been 15 km/hr. 

Let's find the time in which the boy could swim 25 km upstream

**Concept used:**

Upstream speed = Boat speed - speed of the current

Distance = speed × time

**Calculation:**

Upstream speed will be 

⇒ 40 - 15 = 25 km

So, the time taken will be 

⇒ 25 / 25 = 1 hr

**∴ The time in which the boy could swim 25 km upstream in 1 hr.**
